title: Internal Hom with an invertible twist
statement:
Let $K\in D(X,\Lambda)$ be perfect over $\Lambda_X$, that is, dualizable for
$\otimes^L_{\Lambda_X}$, let $T\in D(X,\Lambda)$ be invertible for
$\otimes^L_{\Lambda_X}$ (for instance a Tate twist $\Lambda(m)_X$, $m\in\Z$), and
let $M\in D(X,\Lambda)$. Then the canonical map

$$
\RHom_X\bigl(K,M\otimes^L_{\Lambda_X}T\bigr)\to
\RHom_X(K,M)\otimes^L_{\Lambda_X}T
$$

is an isomorphism; in particular
$\RHom_X(K,\Lambda_X(m)[n])\cong K^\vee(m)[n]$.

proof.text: Equip the coefficient category with the recorded monoidal and symmetric structures. For every Q, transport S.adjunction Q along the inverse of tensorLeftIsoTensorRight Q. This gives a MonoidalClosed structure whose chosen internal Hom functor is exactly Prod.sectR (op Q) B followed by H, with no change of objects or arbitrary comparison isomorphism.

proof.text: Under the transported adjunction, identify sfTwistTensorHomMap with MonoidalClosed.ihomTensorToIhom. Expand their transposes and apply homEquiv_ofNatIsoLeft_apply. The transported evaluation is the recorded right evaluation precomposed with the braiding. Convert inverse braiding to the opposite braiding by symmetry, expand braiding_tensor_left_hom, cancel the adjacent associator and inverse, and cancel the opposite braidings. The two morphisms before transposition are equal, so the canonical maps are equal.

Apply the already proved categorical core MonoidalClosed.isIso_ihomTensorToIhom with hT. Its proof tensors by the inverse twist, uses full faithfulness of tensorRightEquivalenceOfTensorIso and the tensor-Hom bijections, and concludes by isIso_of_yoneda_map_bijective. This is exactly the invertible-twist route of the blueprint and needs no dualizability of P or constructible-generation argument. Rewriting by Step 2 proves sfTwistTensorHomMap_isIso. The existing inverse comparison and unit specialization definitions give the stated inverse and the final unit case unchanged.
